figurative_meaning_en: To become disheartened; to feel dejected or wounded in spirit
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরীক্ষায় খারাপ ফলাফল পেয়ে তার মন ভেঙে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He became disheartened after getting poor exam results.
Her heart broke due to her friend's betrayal.
note: This idiom is widely used in everyday Bengali conversation to express emotional distress.
